label: SN-3002-TR five-pin soil probe (RS485)
notes: The nitrogen_raw, phosphorus_raw and potassium_raw registers (0x0004 to 0x0006) are three functions of one underlying conductivity measurement, not three independent nutrient readings; the writable calibration registers only apply a scale and an offset to that single input, so the three outputs can never be separated. See docs/references.md source 8 and the deployment manual section 7 for the full evidence, including the probe reading nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium as zero together in air.
